movie.title: How to Rob a Bank
movie.overview: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A social media-savvy robbery crew risks everything for their most ambitious heist yet as a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer close in on their viral operation.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A crew of modern bank robbers gains massive viral fame by broadcasting their daring heists live across social media platforms. Unbeknownst to them, their digital footprint draws the combined focus of a seasoned FBI agent and a gifted software engineer. As the relentless law enforcement duo narrows the gap, the ambitious crime ring refuses to back down. Driven by notoriety and high stakes, they push beyond their limits to execute one final, massive robbery.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: A bold group of bank robbers revolutionizes modern crime by broadcasting their high-stakes heists live to millions of online followers. While their viral fame turns them into Internet sensations, it also catches the attention of a relentless veteran FBI agent determined to bring them to justice. Recognizing the digital nature of the crew's operations, the agent partners with a brilliant software engineer to analyze their live streams, metadata, and online footprints. As the technical and tactical investigation gains momentum, the law enforcement duo begins predicting the crew's moves and closing in on their identities. Meanwhile, internal tension builds within the criminal ring as the thrill of fame clashes with the increasing risk of capture. Refusing to lay low, the crew's leader decides to capitalize on their massive audience by orchestrating their most daring and complex bank robbery yet. With the FBI closing off their escape routes and the software engineer dismantling their digital cover, the robbers must gamble everything on a high-octane showdown. The escalating situation forces both sides to push past their physical and technological limits, culminating in an intense battle between viral ambition and justice.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: How to Rob a Bank follows a new generation of criminal mastermind who fuses high-stakes bank robberies with the explosive power of social media. By live-streaming their daring break-ins and taunting authorities online, a crew of robbers achieves instant viral fame, capturing the attention of millions worldwide. However, their public broadcasts also attract a formidable pair of investigators: a grizzled, traditional FBI agent and an expert software engineer capable of dissecting their digital presence. As the investigators race against time to decode the crew's methods and predict their next target, the robbers prepare for an unprecedented final heist that will test the limits of technology, law enforcement, and criminal ambition.

story_structure.climax: The crew executes their most ambitious robbery under intense real-time public and police scrutiny, leading to a high-stakes confrontation with the authorities closing in.
story_structure.conflict: The team's growing online visibility catches the attention of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer, who team up to expose and apprehend them.
story_structure.resolution: The fallout of the final heist determines the fate of the crew and demonstrates the ultimate price of their pursuit of viral notoriety.
story_structure.introduction: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers gains massive viral fame by broadcasting their daring, high-stakes heists online.
story_structure.risingAction: As the law enforcement duo tracks their digital and physical footprints, the robbers refuse to back down, escalating the tension by planning their biggest and most dangerous heist to date.
